scope: Focused extraction from official help articles and search previews. State models are analysis, acceptance tests proposed, not runtime measurements.

patterns.title: Pinned object strip
patterns.documented_behavior: Object is pinned at bottom until explicitly removed. Reordering uses drag; hovering exposes unpin. This is not proof of app tab history or preservation of unsaved state.
patterns.proposed_acceptance_tests: Pin same ID twice, reopen existing object, reorder by keyboard, narrow overflow, permission revoked, deleted item.
patterns.evidence_status: official documentation; no live runtime test

patterns.title: Structured query editor
patterns.documented_behavior: Select field/operator/value and combine with AND/OR nested groups. Text search scope can be selected; visible custom fields are searched. Some filter values prefill newly created records. AI-built filters remain editable and can be reverted.
patterns.proposed_acceptance_tests: Boolean truth table, invalid values, no matches versus failure, clear group, contextual creation preview, AI unmatched constraint disclosure.
patterns.evidence_status: official documentation; no live runtime test

patterns.title: Draft versus shared configuration
patterns.documented_behavior: Changed view displays save control. Save updates all with access, autosave persists future changes, save-as creates separate view, revert removes latest change. Concurrent viewers may need reload; guests cannot save.
patterns.proposed_acceptance_tests: Permission rejection, concurrent change, no accidental duplicate, draft navigation and reload; no assumption of real-time shared propagation.
patterns.evidence_status: official documentation; no live runtime test

patterns.title: One object in multiple groups
patterns.documented_behavior: List can show same item in each matching multi-value group rather than a combined group. The default is combined; setting saved per view, unavailable on Board. All appearances represent one object.
patterns.proposed_acceptance_tests: Same ID across groups, edit reflected everywhere, counts distinct IDs versus occurrences, selection deduplication.
patterns.evidence_status: official documentation; no live runtime test

patterns.title: Semantic status and scoped inheritance
patterns.documented_behavior: Active, Done and Closed have distinct meaning; optional Not Started group. Children inherit statuses unless customized. Done clears dependencies and is not overdue; Closed hidden by default in List. Custom Closed states unavailable; rename possible.
patterns.proposed_acceptance_tests: Move between location schemas, reject unauthorized edit, preserve stable status ID, visible closed toggle, dependency semantics.
patterns.evidence_status: official documentation; no live runtime test

patterns.title: Configurable template application
patterns.documented_behavior: Template can copy selected properties and settings, including dependencies, dates and subtasks. Formula fields excluded. Same-name distinct custom fields may coexist. Applying a task template cannot be undone; update cannot revert to previous version.
patterns.proposed_acceptance_tests: Preview destructive effects, schema mapping, duplicate property names, limits, failure atomicity, explicit irreversible confirmation (proposal).
patterns.evidence_status: official documentation; no live runtime test

patterns.title: Offline capability boundary
patterns.documented_behavior: Notice appears on disconnect. Previously opened tasks and notes readable but not editable; offline task creation syncs on reconnect. Reminders not creatable offline on mobile; subtasks not creatable offline. Tray tasks cached.
patterns.proposed_acceptance_tests: Queue idempotency, reconnect conflict, failed sync, status visible, mobile capability differences; documentation does not establish conflict algorithm.
patterns.evidence_status: official documentation; no live runtime test

patterns.title: Attachment review
patterns.documented_behavior: Add comments at points on image/PDF and at video time; assign, reply and resolve. Video shows timestamps in playback; unavailable for cloud attachments.
patterns.proposed_acceptance_tests: Coordinate transforms with zoom/rotation; page index, media time seek, accessible comment navigation, deleted file/version, permission.
patterns.evidence_status: official documentation; no live runtime test

patterns.title: Conversation versus audit feed
patterns.documented_behavior: New Comments default panel contains discussion and selected high-level updates; Activity retains full history. Task comments now support Chat-style threading, forward and scheduled send. Other comment surfaces not migrated.
patterns.proposed_acceptance_tests: Unread counts, deep link, audit completeness, no duplicate events, legacy surface support and migration.
patterns.evidence_status: official documentation; no live runtime test

patterns.title: Conversation to actionable item
patterns.documented_behavior: Assign a new/existing comment; notify recipient; resolve using checkbox; links from action items navigate to comment. Resolution notification shows actor. Assignment integrates with task closure warning where configured.
patterns.proposed_acceptance_tests: Assignment change, permissions, notification, jump to source, duplicate assignment and reopen behavior (unverified).
patterns.evidence_status: official documentation; no live runtime test

patterns.title: Contextual or pinned editor toolbar
patterns.documented_behavior: Default toolbar appears near selected text; user may pin to top. Commands vary by surface; undo, redo, insert, clear format and Markdown copy documented.
patterns.proposed_acceptance_tests: Focus, selection preservation, keyboard, clipping, touch, disabled command, formatting undo.
patterns.evidence_status: official documentation; no live runtime test

patterns.title: Visual accessibility preference
patterns.documented_behavior: User enables contrast mode. Authenticated Docs toggle-list treatment additionally described in text toolbar article; do not generalize to public or mobile surfaces.
patterns.proposed_acceptance_tests: Measure contrast, visible focus, reduced motion, screen reader and zoom independently; no WCAG conformance assertion.
patterns.evidence_status: official documentation; no live runtime test

patterns.title: Notification grouping and reversible clearing
patterns.documented_behavior: Primary, Other, Later and Cleared tabs; same object notifications grouped; filters persist. Cleared groups recoverable for 30 days; clear-all respects active filter. Open group displays related object/details.
patterns.proposed_acceptance_tests: No duplicate notifications, keyboard parity, filtered bulk scope, restore order, time zone and accessible badge.
patterns.evidence_status: official documentation; no live runtime test

patterns.title: Experimental layout provenance
patterns.documented_behavior: Global rail remains visible; contextual sidebar can collapse and preview on hover. Labs toggle can restore older layout. Recents can pin current page or everywhere. Page navigation can nest under sidebar shortcuts.
patterns.proposed_acceptance_tests: Pointer, keyboard, touch, width, permission, settings persistence and old/new layout migration; not all accounts have same UI.
patterns.evidence_status: official documentation; no live runtime test
